clue.text: Neutral areas for the old folks?

definitions.text: Neutral areas for the old folks?

parts.words: Neutral areas for the old folks?
parts.note: a phrase for no-man's-land between rival forces, read whimsically as regions set aside for old fogeys, since a buffer is British slang for a fusty old man

explanation.surface: A planner wonders whether some quiet districts should be reserved for elderly residents.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old buffer' is British slang for an old-fashioned elderly man, so the second reading turns the phrase into districts for such people.
explanation.definitionFit: Neutral strips separating hostile sides are the standard diplomatic and military term here.

clue.text: Defenders' worry is inferior status

parts.note: in football or rugby, defenders are the backs
to worry is to eat, as in 'what's eating you?'

explanation.surface: A football coach frets that the defence lacks standing.
explanation.walkthrough: The possessive apostrophe misleads: the defenders give BACKS and 'worry' gives EAT, as in 'what's eating him?'.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking a subordinate role is idiomatically sitting in the rear of the car rather than driving.

clue.text: The study of music and poetry tries fan sorely

definitions.text: The study of music and poetry

indicators.note: sorely suggests the words are badly hurt, so the letters of tries fan are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: An arts student's demands wear out an admirer's patience.
explanation.definitionFit: Music and poetry are among the creative disciplines grouped with painting and sculpture.

clue.text: The compiler absorbed by objective to improve!

indicators.note: absorbed by means taken inside, so the setter's word sits within the word for objective

parts.note: an objective is an end or aim
the compiler of a crossword refers to himself as me

explanation.surface: A setter vows to get better by focusing hard on his goal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The compiler' is a crossword convention for the setter speaking of himself; the exclamation mark adds emphasis only.
explanation.definitionFit: To correct and refine a text is to make it better, the editorial sense of the word.

clue.text: Numbers the last letter copied out

parts.note: Z is the last letter of the alphabet

indicators.note: out signals the letters of copied are rearranged, as if put out of order

explanation.surface: Someone tallies figures after a final character has been reproduced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Numbers' is a fair definition because a US postal code is a string of digits.
explanation.definitionFit: The American postal code is a group of digits identifying a delivery area.

clue.text: Symbolic leader of Nigeria worried oilman

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter, here taken from Nigeria
worried suggests the letters of oilman are agitated into a new order

explanation.surface: A Nigerian head of state is said to fret over an oil executive.
explanation.definitionFit: Something existing in name only is token or figurative rather than real.

clue.text: Training fish with one — no good!

parts.note: fish swim in a school, so the group word stands for them
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A complaint that a fishing lesson with someone proved useless.
explanation.definitionFit: Education or instruction is formal preparation for a role.

clue.text: Container for grass

definitions.meaning: a vessel such as a jar or cooking pan

explanation.definitionFit: A cooking vessel, and slang for marijuana, both share this short word.

clue.text: Example is script placed in front of writer

definitions.text: Example is script placed in front of writer

parts.words: Example is script placed in front of writer
parts.note: the word script attached at the start of the word writer is one instance of a word part fixed before another

explanation.surface: A screenwriter's credit puts the script ahead of the author's name.
explanation.definitionFit: A word element fixed at the front of another, like script before writer in scriptwriter, is the grammar term described.

clue.text: One experiences some discomfort as terrorist

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A hostage describes feeling uneasy in the presence of a terrorist.
explanation.definitionFit: A sampler or tester is a person who tries things out, the agent noun of experiencing.

clue.text: Nothing invested in staff transport

indicators.note: invested in means put inside, so the zero goes within the stick

parts.note: a staff is a walking stick or cane
nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: A complaint that no money has been put into the workers' buses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'staff' looks like employees but is a stick, CANE.
explanation.definitionFit: A light paddled boat is a means of getting across water.

clue.text: Note including a rate allowed for flyers

indicators.note: including means the note's letters surround the other pieces

parts.note: PS is a postscript, a note added to a letter
MPH, miles per hour, is a rate of speed
to let is to allow

explanation.surface: A memo mentions a permitted fee for pilots.
explanation.definitionFit: Leaflets handed out or posted are printed sheets, an everyday sense of fliers.

clue.text: Resign, depressed by support

indicators.note: by means next to, so the word for depressed sits beside the word for support

parts.note: a stand is a support
down means low in spirits

explanation.surface: An official quits, dispirited despite being backed.
explanation.definitionFit: To withdraw from an office or post is to step aside from it.

clue.text: Express a view on old wood

parts.note: pine is a wood

explanation.surface: Someone gives their opinion about antique timber.
explanation.definitionFit: To state an opinion is a formal verb for voicing thoughts.

clue.text: Sound wood on a new item for collectors

indicators.note: on means placed after, so the sounded wood comes after the other pieces in this across entry
sound tells us to take how the word for wood is pronounced, not how it is spelt

parts.note: teak is a hardwood

explanation.surface: A dealer judges a solid timber piece to be a fresh collectible.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like an adjective meaning solid but asks for TEAK said aloud, spelt TIQUE.
explanation.definitionFit: An old piece valued by connoisseurs is the classic thing people collect.

clue.text: Digging out target for hunter — one needing grouse, initially

parts.note: a quarry is the animal a hunter pursues
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: initially means take the first letters of needing and grouse

explanation.surface: A hunter's prey needs a game bird to start with.
explanation.definitionFit: Extracting stone from a pit is excavating, the industrial sense of the verb.

clue.text: Both sides welcome first-class accommodation in the retreat

indicators.note: to welcome is to take in, so the left and right letters surround the top-quality pair

parts.note: left and right are the two sides, L and R
AI (A1) means first-class

explanation.surface: Two parties greet luxury lodgings at a holiday hideaway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Both sides' gives L and R, left and right, which take in AI, a variant of A1.
explanation.definitionFit: A wild animal's den is the dwelling where it hides away.

clue.text: Something that lives on zero margins, perhaps

parts.note: zero is the letter O

indicators.note: perhaps signals that margins may be rearranged into another word

explanation.surface: A business survives on wafer-thin profit margins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'zero margins' suggests no profit; O stands at the front of the anagram of MARGINS.
explanation.definitionFit: A living being, plant or animal, is the biologist's general term.

clue.text: Elementary variants causing posies to change form

indicators.note: change form says the letters of posies to are rearranged into a new shape

explanation.surface: A florist's bouquets are reshaped for some reason.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Elementary' means of chemical elements here, not simple.
explanation.definitionFit: Atoms of one element with different neutron counts are forms of that element.

clue.text: Short story about cosmetic preparation

indicators.note: short means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a tale is a story
C is circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: A brief anecdote concerns a beauty product.
explanation.definitionFit: The fine powder used on skin is a toiletry or makeup product.

clue.text: Blade forged from copper salts process

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

indicators.note: to process is to work over, so the letters of salts are reworked

explanation.surface: A metal tool made in a chemistry lab from copper compounds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'forged from' is link, though it suits the surface; 'process' turns SALTS into TLASS.
explanation.definitionFit: A short curved sword is a type of edged weapon, the pirate's sword.

clue.text: Understands people

definitions.meaning: works out, as in '... it out'

explanation.definitionFit: To reckon something out, and prominent individuals, are both senses of the plural noun-verb.

clue.text: Avoid terror engulfing world

indicators.note: engulfing means swallowing up, so the word for terror surrounds the word for world

parts.note: fear is terror
an orb is a globe, the world

explanation.surface: A warning to steer clear of dread spreading across the globe.
explanation.definitionFit: To refrain from doing something is to hold back or abstain.

clue.text: Freezing point?

parts.note: not the temperature where water turns solid but a frozen pointed thing hanging from a gutter

explanation.definitionFit: A tapering spike of frozen dripping water is literally a point formed by freezing.

clue.text: Quartz container holding contents of 25

indicators.note: holding means the container's letters go round the inner letters

parts.note: a jar is a container

indicators.note: contents of means the inside letters of the answer to clue 25

parts.note: 25 refers to the answer of 25-down, the tree

explanation.surface: A jar holds the inside of a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 25 is 25-down, ASPEN, whose contents are SPE.
explanation.definitionFit: This red or brown opaque gemstone is a variety of chalcedony, a form of silica.

clue.text: Locks put on key seat

indicators.note: put on means placed after, so the locks follow the key

parts.note: C is a musical key
locks are hair

explanation.surface: Someone fits locks onto a key to secure a seat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Locks' and 'key' suggest security, but they are hair and a musical key.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece of furniture with a back for one person to sit on.

clue.text: Woman screaming at a good worker on call?

indicators.note: on means placed after, so the remaining pieces follow the word for call

parts.note: to term something is to call or name it
an ant is a worker, often of the insect colony

explanation.surface: A woman yells at a reliable employee on standby.
explanation.definitionFit: A shrewish, violent, overbearing female is the old literary sense.

clue.text: Tree snake seen regularly

parts.note: an asp is a snake

indicators.note: regularly means take alternate letters of seen

explanation.surface: A serpent is spotted often in the woods.
explanation.definitionFit: A poplar with trembling leaves is a species of deciduous tree.

clue.text: A source of talent in prisoner provides charm

indicators.note: in means these letters are placed inside the word for prisoner

parts.note: a captive is a prisoner

indicators.note: the source of talent is its first letter

explanation.surface: A gifted inmate is credited with charisma.
explanation.definitionFit: To enchant or fascinate someone is to win them over.

clue.text: Edge in very quietly and dress

indicators.note: in means the word for edge is placed inside the musical mark

parts.note: pp, pianissimo, is the musical direction for very quietly
a rim is an edge

explanation.surface: Someone sidles in silently and gets dressed.
explanation.walkthrough: PP is pianissimo, the musical marking for very quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: To groom fussily is to smarten oneself up.

clue.text: Show of hesitation, accepting a prize for bullfighting

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so the hesitation sound surrounds the single letter

parts.note: er is the sound people make when hesitating

explanation.surface: A matador falters when offered an award.
explanation.walkthrough: A successful matador may be awarded one of the bull's ears as a trophy.
explanation.definitionFit: A matador is traditionally awarded an organ of hearing cut from the bull as a trophy.

clue.text: People who enjoy eating roast nuts are welcomed by financiers

indicators.note: welcomed by means taken in, so the rearranged letters go inside the bankers

parts.note: the gnomes of Zurich is a nickname for Swiss bankers

indicators.note: nuts means crazy, so the letters of roast are scrambled

explanation.surface: Bankers host guests who love roasted nuts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nuts' looks like food but is the anagram signal on ROAST; 'gnomes of Zurich' is a nickname for Swiss bankers.
explanation.definitionFit: Connoisseurs of good food are gourmets who relish fine dining.
